designNotes: Warm textured paper, oversized cobalt crayon headlines, smiling orange-cat artwork and large source-based prototype screens create a playful two-frame story. Timeline and detail now have distinct purposes. Twenty master images are generated individually with built-in image_gen.
previewLimitations: Selected published React Native prototype source snapshots rendered offline with inert adapters, one fictional local record, descriptive visual sample observations and a generated crayon drawing. Published source commit and current working-tree differences are recorded in ui/source-reuse-proof.json; current working edits are preserved. Headers/tabs are host approximations; AI posters approximate those UI renders. No live analysis, psychological assessment, native runtime, language support or camera operation was validated. Phone UI remains English.
activeSelection: Use exports.json here; all previous artwork is preserved in its original folders.
